verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.englishText: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.englishText: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -

verses.arabicText: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.englishText: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.

verses.arabicText: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.englishText: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
verses.englishText: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

verses.arabicText: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.englishText: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].

verses.arabicText: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
verses.englishText: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,[1761] persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
verses.englishText: Then I invited them publicly.

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
verses.englishText: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

verses.arabicText: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
verses.englishText: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

verses.arabicText: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
verses.englishText: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

verses.arabicText: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
verses.englishText: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

verses.arabicText: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
verses.englishText: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur

verses.arabicText: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
verses.englishText: While He has created you in stages?[1762]
verses.footnotes: [1762] i.e., in various progressive states and conditions. See also 22:5 and 23:12-14 in reference to development of the embryo.

verses.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
verses.englishText: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers[1763]

verses.arabicText: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
verses.englishText: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

verses.arabicText: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
verses.englishText: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
verses.englishText: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

verses.arabicText: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
verses.englishText: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse

verses.arabicText: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
verses.englishText: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"

verses.arabicText: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.englishText: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

verses.arabicText: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
verses.englishText: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
verses.englishText: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'[1764]
verses.footnotes: [1764] These were the names of specific idols named after pious men of earlier generations.

verses.arabicText: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
verses.englishText: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

verses.arabicText: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
verses.englishText: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.englishText: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verses.englishText: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

verses.arabicText: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
verses.englishText: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
